notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
